cards.title: Oracle says the data centre is on schedule — and sent a notice letting it stop paying if it isn't
cards.why: It puts a price on the who-funds-the-AI-capex question: the lender fell 4.12% against the tenant's 4.18%, on the same afternoon, with $18bn of stressed debt behind it.

cards.title: The headline said new home sales rose 6.4%. The same sentence said give or take 19.5%.
cards.why: A fully primary-sourced lesson in reading a government release, evergreen for family investors and reusable every month the figure prints.
